never said I didn't use AI , i said it had nun to do w recording process . I didn't even know what da app was till we mixed …

He also says the company is aiming to partner with "distribution platforms on combatting fraud and misuse."

summary: Suno is implementing new watermarking technology and download policies to limit the spread of spammy AI music tracks and increase transparency, as outlined in a blog post by CEO Mikey Shulman.
